# Specific Role Rule 2: Assistants/D-Class
- Assistant is a role intended for new players to learn how to play the game. - Hijacking either of these roles to self antag will result in a server ban. - If you want to freely self antag, enable insurgent in your character settings. It is assistant/d-class with self-antag rights. - d-class only refers to crew-aligned d-class.
